nodes.text: State your business. The arch stays clear.

choices.text: Old Maren said I should speak with you.
What does the watch watch for?

nodes.text: Goblins test the south road when the moon runs thin, and _something in Gloomhollow has the miners spooked_. Keep your blade oiled and your boasts small.
Maren vouches for you? Hm. That's worth more than a letter from a crown. Very well — you'll have the watch's courtesy, and my name: *Alda*. Don't wear either out.
The gate. The roads. The gloom past the treeline. And lately that Riftgate — it hums louder some nights. _If it ever starts singing, you run and you find me._
Then pass. Keep your hands where the watch can see them.
